mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO llm_call_log (platform, bot_id, group_id, run_kind, run_id, slot_code, provider_code, model_id, input_tokens, output_tokens, cached_tokens, cost_amount, ttft_ms, total_ms, stop_reason, error_code, trace_id, is_replay) VALUES
(#{row.platform}, #{row.botId}, #{row.groupId}, #{row.runKind}, #{row.runId}, #{row.slotCode}, #{row.providerCode}, #{row.modelId}, #{row.inputTokens}, #{row.outputTokens}, #{row.cachedTokens}, #{row.costAmount}, #{row.ttftMs}, #{row.totalMs}, #{row.stopReason}, #{row.errorCode}, #{row.traceId}, #{row.replay})
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, run_kind AS runKind, run_id AS runId, slot_code AS slotCode, provider_code AS providerCode, model_id AS modelId, input_tokens AS inputTokens, output_tokens AS outputTokens, cached_tokens AS cachedTokens, cost_amount AS costAmount, ttft_ms AS ttftMs, total_ms AS totalMs, stop_reason AS stopReason, error_code AS errorCode, trace_id AS traceId, is_replay AS replay, created_at AS createdAt FROM llm_call_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT MAX(id) FROM llm_call_log WHERE is_replay = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cached_tokens), 0) AS cachedTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cost_amount), 0) AS costAmount FROM llm_call_log WHERE is_replay = 1 AND id > #{sinceId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cached_tokens), 0) AS cachedTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cost_amount), 0) AS costAmount FROM llm_call_log WHERE run_kind = #{runKind} AND id > #{sinceId}

SELECT run_id AS dimensionKey, COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cached_tokens), 0) AS cachedTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cost_amount), 0) AS costAmount FROM llm_call_log WHERE is_replay = 0 AND run_id IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} GROUP BY run_id HAVING COALESCE(SUM(cost_amount), 0) > #{minCost} ORDER BY costAmount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
